title: VETA Trading Platform
description: A near-real-world trading platform for paper-trading algorithmic strategies against simulated and real market data, built to help people learn market dynamics without risking capital.
imageAlt: VETA trading terminal showing a live market ladder, orders, and positions panels

title: Night Watch
description: A satellite ground station app for METEOR-M LRPT and ISS SSTV reception, with live pass tracking, an FFT waterfall, and automatic scheduling. Docker-ready for Raspberry Pi 4/5.
imageAlt: Night Watch satellite ground station dashboard showing live tracking and an FFT waterfall

title: esheep
description: A desktop sheep you can grab and toss. Electron and TypeScript, with a thoroughly tested core and a playable browser demo.
imageAlt: A pixel-art sheep walking across a desktop in the esheep browser demo

title: Two Meter Watch
description: A public monitor for the 2-metre amateur band (144–146 MHz) with a waterfall, band activity and SSTV detection. RTL-SDR on a Raspberry Pi, and a sibling to Night Watch.
imageAlt: Two Meter Watch dashboard showing a 2-metre band waterfall and recent activity

title: Arduino Temperature Control Library
description: The de-facto Arduino/ESP32 library for Maxim/Dallas 1-Wire temperature sensors (DS18B20 and family). Widely used across the embedded hobbyist and IoT ecosystem.
imageAlt: Live sensor data dashboard showing a temperature graph over time

title: TeslaCam
description: Automates backup, cloud storage, and remote access for Tesla dash-cam footage using a Raspberry Pi Zero W.
imageAlt: Tesla center console showing dash-cam footage on screen with a laptop running the TeslaCam software
